messages:
Riley Chan: Heads up 1: Meridian procurement wants to shorten the renewal to 9 months and asked for monthly invoices. They also need vendor code on each invoice and want the Okta SSO appendix visible before signing. Redline: https://docsend.example/meridian-9mo
Arjun S.: What concession are they asking for? Need to confirm numbers before we respond.
Riley Chan: They requested an 8% concession on the 9mo total. Current ARR = $200k -> 9mo pro-rata = $150k -> with 8% concession = $138,000 total -> monthly ≈ $15,333.
Becky L.: Finance: monthly invoicing OK. Net60 requires validated PO with vendor code and billing entity. Without PO default payment is card/wire. Approve 8% as one-off if signed this quarter.
LegalOps: Okta appendix is fine as an exhibit. We can include it in DocuSign and show the exhibit pre-signature. Minimal attestation to include SSO owner/contact.
Arjun S.: I'll tell the customer we can do 9mo with 8% concession, monthly invoices, Net60 with PO+vendor code, and that we'll send DocuSign with the Okta appendix attached.
Riley Chan: Sending PO template to procurement now.
Riley Chan: PO template:
PO Number: _____
Purchasing Org: Meridian Corp.
Vendor Code: _____
Billing Entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Contract Term: 9 months
Invoice Frequency: Monthly
Payment Terms: Net60 (with PO)
Total Amount: $138,000
Billing Contact: billing@meridian.example
Arjun S.: Customer replied: "Routing PO now. Vendor code MER-07X. Can you surface the Okta appendix before signature?"
LegalOps: Yes, we'll prepare DocuSign with the appendix visible and an SSO contact checkbox.
FinanceBot: Reminder: once PO + signed envelope received, billing will queue monthly invoices and attach PO to the first invoice.
Riley Chan: Marking as in-flight. Will update when PO PDF and signed DocuSign available.
